mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in 3 instances (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in economic demand (GDPC1) and labor market tightness (PAYEMS falling) creates a virtuous cycle of corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 6-month rolling window despite both proxies trending positively.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies equity valuation growth by lowering discount rates, producing significantly higher S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline in late-cycle periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions reflected by falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE < 4% in 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trajectory in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when INDPRO rises >5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous strength of economic demand (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) creates a feedback loop of rising corporate profits and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 6-month rolling window despite both proxies trending positively.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary gap regime, a sharp decline in economic demand (GDPC1) reduces corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when GDPC1 falls >10% in a quarter during recessionary gap periods.
